topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Well, now, I can't rightly say I know much about the world beyond our parish bounds, but I've been hearin' a tale that's got more twists'n a vine in summertime. They say an artist, one who paints fine pictures with colors as bright as spring flowers, found his work marked on a man's arm, like the mark of a spade on good earth. The artist, he didn't do no such thing; it was done by someone else, without a word to him. Whispers run thick that the artist ain't takin' kindly to this, like a cloud gathering before a storm. I reckon it’s a strange business, one that makes the hairs on the back of my neck stand on end, as if the saints themselves were muttering in the wind.
